q: What does the power layout in an electrical permit set contain?
o: Floor plans, legend, general notes, schedule of loads and riser diagram
Only the lighting fixtures and switches
Only the site and vicinity maps
ref: RA 7920 (New Electrical Engineering Law); NBC Revised IRR Rule XIII; PEC 2017
n: The power layout shows outlets and circuits, with the load schedule and riser diagram that size the feeders.

q: Under RA 7920, which are the licensed electrical practitioners?
ref: RA 7920 (New Electrical Engineering Law); NBC Revised IRR Rule XIII; PEC 2017
n: Professional Electrical Engineer, Registered Electrical Engineer and Registered Master Electrician. ECE and RMP are separate professions.

q: What may a Registered Electrical Engineer (REE) do under RA 7920?
o: Seal all electrical plans of any size, alone
Design and supervise within the limits the law sets for REEs, including operation and maintenance
ref: RA 7920 (New Electrical Engineering Law); NBC Revised IRR Rule XIII; PEC 2017
n: Sealing plans is reserved to the PEE; the RME does installation and wiring work.

q: Under the NBC IRR, what must electrical systems and installations conform to?
o: The Philippine Electrical Code, Parts 1 and 2
ref: RA 7920 (New Electrical Engineering Law); NBC Revised IRR Rule XIII; PEC 2017
n: Electrical rules sit in Rule XIII of the NBC IRR, which adopts the PEC.

q: What are electrical permit working drawings referenced to?
o: The architectural floor plans and reflected ceiling plans
ref: RA 7920 (New Electrical Engineering Law); NBC Revised IRR Rule XIII; PEC 2017
n: Outlets, fixtures and panels must be located against the architectural plans they serve.

q: In the NBC Revised IRR, which rule covers electrical regulations?
ref: RA 7920 (New Electrical Engineering Law); NBC Revised IRR Rule XIII; PEC 2017
n: Rule XIII covers electrical regulations; Rule XIV covers mechanical and Rule XV plumbing and sanitary.

q: Which edition of the Philippine Electrical Code Part 1 is current, effective 2 December 2017?
ref: RA 7920 (New Electrical Engineering Law); NBC Revised IRR Rule XIII; PEC 2017
n: The PRBEE adopted PEC 2017 Part 1 through Resolution No. 18, series of 2017.

q: What did the 2024 revised electrical engineering Code of Ethics repeal?
ref: RA 7920 (New Electrical Engineering Law); NBC Revised IRR Rule XIII; PEC 2017
n: A new code of ethics replaces the old board resolution, not the law or the code.

q: Besides floor plans, legend and notes, what else does the lighting layout sheet in a permit set include?
o: Site plan, location plan and vicinity map
Schedule of loads and riser diagram
ref: RA 7920 (New Electrical Engineering Law); NBC Revised IRR Rule XIII; PEC 2017
n: The first sheet of an electrical set usually carries the site, location and vicinity maps.

q: Which resolution issued the revised Code of Ethics for electrical engineering practitioners?
ref: RA 7920 (New Electrical Engineering Law); NBC Revised IRR Rule XIII; PEC 2017
n: Resolution No. 18 (2017) adopted the PEC; No. 65 (2024) adopted the new ethics code.

ref: RA 7920 (New Electrical Engineering Law); NBC Revised IRR Rule XIII; PEC 2017
n: RA 9292 is Electronics, RA 8495 is Mechanical, and RA 9266 is Architecture.

q: Under RA 7920, which of these is part of electrical engineering practice?
o: Preparing plans, specifications and estimates for electrical systems
ref: RA 7920 (New Electrical Engineering Law); NBC Revised IRR Rule XIII; PEC 2017
n: Design, supervision and consulting on power systems, distribution and wiring are electrical practice.

q: What is the field of a Registered Master Electrician (RME)?
o: Installing, wiring, operating, maintaining and repairing electrical equipment
ref: RA 7920 (New Electrical Engineering Law); NBC Revised IRR Rule XIII; PEC 2017
n: The RME works on installation and maintenance; sealing plans is for the PEE.

q: Who prepares the electrical analysis (design analysis) in a permit set?
ref: RA 7920 (New Electrical Engineering Law); NBC Revised IRR Rule XIII; PEC 2017
n: Load and short-circuit calculations back the design, so they carry the PEE's seal.

q: Under RA 7920, who alone may seal electrical plans?
ref: RA 7920 (New Electrical Engineering Law); NBC Revised IRR Rule XIII; PEC 2017
n: Sealing is reserved to the PEE, the highest of the three electrical licenses.
